name: Paloma Plaza
summary: Paloma Plaza is a 69,000 square foot retail center completed in 2006, serving the affluent Silvercreek neighborhood of South San Jose. This $20 million development by Barry Swenson Builder provides convenient shopping and services to one of the area's most desirable residential communities.
demographics: Paloma Plaza serves the affluent Silvercreek neighborhood of South San Jose, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+. The primary trade area consists of young professionals, established families with children, and tech industry workers drawn to the area's excellent schools and newer housing developments. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday services and dining options close to home in well-maintained retail environments.
description: Paloma Plaza is a modern commercial retail center located in the desirable Silvercreek area of San Jose, California. Completed in January 2006 with a project investment of $20 million, this 69,000 square foot development was both designed and constructed by Barry Swenson Builder, a respected name in Bay Area development known for quality construction and architectural excellence. Strategically positioned at 3005 Silvercreek Road, the center serves the thriving South San Jose community with convenient access to one of the area's most sought-after residential neighborhoods. The plaza represents a thoughtful approach to neighborhood retail, providing essential services and amenities to the growing Silvercreek community. Developed by Paloma Properties LLC, the center has established itself as a reliable shopping destination for local residents seeking quality retail and dining options close to home.
